name: Story dressed in Blue
source:
Step into the shoes of Remí, a young man who spends his nights guiding restless spirits to their final resting places. 

But tonight, one particularly stubborn spirit refuses to move on… unless Remí fulfills a mysterious request.

[From [url=https://filip-kuros-grenar.itch.io/story-dressed-in-blue]Itch.io[/url]]
